verdict.rationale: Munito AI's own docs list prompt caching as a supported capability. That is a direct first-party claim, but it is only a one-line mention in a capabilities list, with no detail on how caching works or what it saves. Missing for 10: documentation of caching mechanics (automatic vs explicit cache control, prefix rules, TTL), evidence of latency or cost reduction (cached-token pricing or discounts), which models and APIs support it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can benefit from prompt/prefix caching that reduces latency or cost on repeated context

citations.quote: Capabilities: structured outputs, tool calls, vision, speech to text, streaming, reasoning and prompt caching.
